meta.name: The Sisters Grimm
meta.description: One year after their parents' mysterious disappearance, sisters Sabrina and Daphne move to a magical town where fairytales are real and secrets lurk behind every corner.

videos.title: Relda
videos.overview: Sabrina and Daphne arrive in Ferryport to start a new chapter with their eccentric grandmother.

videos.title: Puck
videos.overview: The sisters team up with Puck, the town's resident trickster, to rescue Relda and Mr. Canis from a giant's pocket.

videos.title: Jack
videos.overview: Sabrina and Daphne stage a jailbreak with the help of a magic carpet.

videos.title: Prince Charming
videos.overview: At Mayor Charming's ball, the girls secretly gather intel on the Grimm family legacy.

videos.title: The Giant (1)
videos.overview: After learning the truth about the giants, the sisters gear up to stop them once and for all.

videos.title: The Giant (2)
videos.overview: The Grimms band together and put up a fight to keep Ferryport Landing safe.

videos.title: Bella
videos.overview: Sabrina and Daphne start at a new school, hopeful for a taste of normal life.

videos.title: Anansi
videos.overview: Mayor Charming tasks the Grimms with untangling a web of clues.

videos.title: Charlie
videos.overview: Puck plays bodyguard for a day while strange things keep happening at school.

videos.title: Wendell
videos.overview: The Grimms track down Wendell, who reveals information that opens a new lead.

videos.title: The Pied Piper
videos.overview: A shrinking potion leads to a tunnel mystery. Mayor Charming offers Sabrina a powerful gift.

videos.title: Rumpelstiltskin
videos.overview: Sabrina must choose between saving the Everafters and finally finding her parents.
